coordinateSystem: Released ADAM body-fixed Cartesian axes; positive Z is the north pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary prime-meridian display phase
source: Vernazza et al. (2021), Table A.1: ecliptic J2000 lambda 101 deg, beta 48 deg, period 15.07081 h; equatorial J2000 conversion uses obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The public parameter file is preserved; the Shape view does not interpret it as an IAU prime-meridian ephemeris.
